description.value: Rum Island (Isle-de-Lis Marine Provincial Park) is a small Gulf Islands park near Sidney, reachable only by boat or kayak; there is no road or trail access, making it effectively off-limits for loaded touring cyclists.

raw_osm.description: 3 tent pads 150 m above beach. 2 pit toilets. Hammock opportunities. Fee charged May - Sept. No fires, including below high tide mark. Possible overflow site on tombolo.
raw_osm.description:approach: Easy on exposed gravel, pebble tombolo between Rum and Gooch Islands. Choose either N or S aspect depending on conditions.
raw_osm.description:other: On Rum Island. Small attractive island with views, trail. seal, bird colonies. Isle de Lis (Lily Island) name given by former owner. Gulf Islands National Park Reserve.
raw_osm.name: Rum Island

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM-linked URL returns a 404 page-not-found (BC Marine Trails has moved site pages to a members-only interactive map), so all campsite details derive exclusively from OSM tags. OSM clearly documents this as a backcountry Parks Canada campsite on Rum Island in the Gulf Islands National Park Reserve with 3 tent pads, 2 pit toilets, and tombolo approach access. No website content was available to corroborate or contradict the OSM data.
concerns: The OSM-linked URL (https://www.bcmarinetrails.org/map_site/12235) returns a 404 page-not-found; BC Marine Trails has moved site-specific pages to a members-only interactive map, so no website content was available for verification.
This is an island campsite accessible only via tombolo on foot or by kayak — not directly accessible by bicycle; cycling tourists would need to combine this with a paddling trip.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, confirmed backcountry campsite within Gulf Islands National Park Reserve operated by Parks Canada, open to the public and of interest to touring cyclists exploring the Sidney area who combine cycling with paddling.
enrichment_extras.notes: Capacity is 3 tent pads with a possible overflow site on the tombolo. No fires permitted anywhere on the island. OSM tags indicate cash payment accepted for the seasonal fee (May–September). Hammock opportunities noted in OSM description.

wow_evidence: effectively off-limits for loaded touring cyclists
